newsitem.title: USA: Champion to focus on cost-cutting in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Champion to focus on cost-cutting in 1997.

text.p: Champion International Corp said on Thursday pulp and paper prices going into the first quarter were lower than fourth quarter averages, but it remained committed to cutting costs and capital spending.
The company reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.11 per share compared to $2.26 per share in the same period last year, and cited much lower prices for all of the company's pulp and paper grades.
But the company said price increases had been announced for newsprint and most uncoated freesheet grades.
